sources.title: Decree No. 2299/PR/PM/MSPI/2025 fixing foreigner admission and stay conditions
sources.publisher: Journal officiel de la République du Tchad
sources.officialityEvidence: The cited government-domain Official Journal PDF is the decree record. Its direct endpoint returned HTTP 502 during the 24 August 2026 review, so this candidate does not rely on an indexed excerpt to establish any nationality rule.

sources.title: e-Visa Tchad: legal notice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Integration, International Cooperation and Diaspora / Ministry of the Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The live legal notice identifies the Foreign Ministry as the host and the Interior Ministry's Immigration Directorate as the content authority for evisa.td.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La rédaction des contenus est assurée par le ministère de l’intérieur (direction de l’immigration).

sources.title: New visa tariffs in the Republic of Chad
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration and E-Visa Subdirectorate
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 11 May 2026 Immigration and E-Visa Subdirectorate notice implements Decree 2299 and says the official evisa.td platform is fully operational for new visa requests.
sources.supportingExcerpt: toutes les demandes de visa se font désormais exclusivement en ligne via plateforme officielle evisa.td

sources.title: E-Visa circular
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration / E-Visa Subdirectorate
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 4 June 2026 circular identifies evisa.td as the official electronic-visa platform under Decree 2299 and states pre-entry submission and processing periods.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Demande de e-Visa standard : 10 jours ouvrables; Demande de e-Visa express: 72 heures

sources.title: e-Visa Tchad: current visa-exempt countries
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration / E-Visa Subdirectorate
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official e-Visa portal names visa-exempt countries, but does not say that its displayed list exhausts every Article 13 agreement state or state an ordinary-passport scope for every entry.
